title: Fleet depot charging | VoltHaven
text: VoltHaven builds AC and DC charging for commercial fleet depots. Our 22 kW bidirectional depot charger supports ISO 15118-20. Contact sales for pricing.

title: Depot V2G is taking off in Germany
author: Lena Krause
text: Fleet operators in Germany are buying bidirectional depot chargers after the new grid-fee rules. Several vendors, including VoltHaven and Ladewerk, report record orders.
